paymentMethods.name: CBE Bank (Commercial Bank of Ethiopia)
paymentMethods.instructions: Please transfer the required amount to our CBE account. Make sure to enter your full name as the transfer reference and upload a clear screenshot of the completed transaction receipt.

paymentMethods.name: Telebirr Wallet

paymentMethods.name: Awash Bank

translations.om: Ibsa guutuu amala, specifications, ykn dhimma dhiyaate irratti galchi.
translations.am: ስለሚቀርበው ነገር ዝርዝር መግለጫ፣ ባህሪያት、 ዝርዝሮች ወይም መረጃዎችን ያስገቡ።

translations.en: Add Image from Phone or Camera
translations.om: Bilbila ykn Kaameraa irraa Fakkii Dabali

translations.en: Clicking this button will instantly publish this property listing live on the Sof Umer digital marketplace.
translations.om: Fayyadama kana cuqaasuun beeksisa qabeenya keetii battalatti gabaa dijitaalaa Sof Umer irratti baasa.
translations.am: ይህን ቁልፍ ሲጫኑ የንብረትዎ ማስታወቂያ ወዲያውኑ በሶፍ ኡመር ዲጂታል ገበያ ላይ በቀጥታ ይወጣል።

notifications.title: New Device Login Detected
notifications.message: A new login was detected from a Desktop device (Unknown). If this wasn't you, please change your password or log out of all devices immediately.

appFeatures.contentEn: Join our growing team and shape the future of Ethiopian marketplace. We are looking for talented developers, marketers, and operations managers.
appFeatures.contentOm: Garee keenya dabalataa jiruun dabalamaa fi egeree daldala Itoophiyaa ijaaraa. Ogeeyyii bilisa ta'an, gurgurtoota fi bulchitoota barbaanna.
appFeatures.contentAm: እያደገ ካለው ቡድናችን ጋር ይቀላቀሉ እና የኢትዮጵያን የገበያ ቦታ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ይቅረጹ። ጎበዝ ገንቢዎችን፣ ገበያተኞችን እና የስራ ማስኬጃ አስተዳዳሪዎችን እንፈልጋለን።

appFeatures.contentEn: Have questions, feedback, or need premium advertising deals? Reach out to us directly through this contact portal or our physical head office in Addis Ababa.
appFeatures.contentOm: Gaaffii, yaada qabdu ykn beeksisa dabalataa barbaaddaa? Toora quunnamtii kanaan ykn biiroo keenya guddaa Finfinnee jiruun quunnamaa.
appFeatures.contentAm: ጥያቄዎች፣ አስተያየቶች አሉዎት ወይስ ልዩ የማስታወቂያ ስምምነቶች ይፈልጋሉ? በዚህ የግንኙነት ፖርታል ወይም በአዲስ አበባ በሚገኘው ዋና መሥሪያ ቤታችን በኩል በቀጥታ ያግኙን።

appFeatures.contentEn: Named after the legendary Sof Omar Caves in Bale, Ethiopia, Sof Umer represents depth, safety, connectivity, and robust local heritage. Established in 2026, we serve as Ethiopia's premier multi-lingual property and product marketplace.
appFeatures.contentOm: Eenyummaan keenya holqa beekamaa Sof Omar Bale keessa jiru irraa kan moggaafame yoo ta'u, daldala amansiisaa, nageenya, fi seenaa naannoo keenyaa calaqqisiisa. Bara 2026 keessatti hundeeffame.
appFeatures.contentAm: ስሙ በባሌ፣ ኢትዮጵያ ከሚገኘው ታዋቂው የሶፍ ኡመር ዋሻዎች የተወሰደ ሲሆን፥ ጥልቀትን፣ ደህንነትን እና ጠንካራ የአካባቢ ቅርሶችን ይወክላል። በ2026 የተመሰረተ።

appFeatures.contentEn: A simple 3-step guide to get started: 1. Create an Account in seconds. 2. Publish your property or products with custom attributes. 3. Connect with verified buyers or tenants safely.
appFeatures.contentOm: Adeemsa salphaa sadii: 1. Herrega banadhu. 2. Beeksisa kee qabeenyaan galchi. 3. Bittoota amansiisoo ta'anii fi kireeffattoota waliin wal-qunnami.
appFeatures.contentAm: ለመጀመር ቀላል ባለ 3-ደረጃ መመሪያ፦ 1. በሰከንዶች ውስጥ መለያ ይፍጠሩ። 2. ንብረትዎን ወይም ምርቶችዎን ያትሙ። 3. ከተረጋገጡ ገዢዎች ወይም ተከራዮች ጋር በደህና ይገናኙ።

appFeatures.contentEn: Rules everyone must follow to keep our community safe, clean, and trusted: 1. Authentic & Accurate Listings. 2. Property Ownership Verification. 3. Respectful Communication.
appFeatures.contentOm: Hawaasa amansiisaa fi qulqulluu ijaaruuf seera hordofamuu qabu: 1. Dhugummaa Beeksisaa. 2. Mirkaneessa Abbummaa. 3. Qunnamtii Kabaja Qabu.
appFeatures.contentAm: ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና እውነተኛ ማህበረሰብ ለመፍጠር ሁሉም ሰው መከተል ያለበት ህጎች፦ 1. እውነተኛ እና ትክክለኛ መረጃ። 2. የባለቤትነት ማረጋገጫ። 3. መልካም ስነ-ምግባር እና ክብር።

appFeatures.contentEn: Get the trusted green check badge on your listings by verifying your property ownership with valid deeds and government-issued ID card photocopies.
appFeatures.contentOm: Beeksisa keessan irratti mallattoo mirkanaa'aa argachuuf waraqaa kaartaa fi eenyummaa keessan nuuf ergaa.
appFeatures.contentAm: የባለቤትነት ማረጋገጫ ካርታ እና መታወቂያ ለአስተዳዳሪው በማጋራት የተረጋገጠ አረንጓዴ ባጅ ያግኙ።

appFeatures.contentEn: Best practices for safe trading: 1. Inspect properties in person before any cash transfer. 2. Meet in busy public places. 3. Beware of upfront payment requests.
appFeatures.contentOm: Nageenya keessaniif: 1. Maallaqa kaffaluun dura ijaan sakatta'aa. 2. Iddoo ummataatti wal-argaa. 3. Kaffaltii dursaa irraa of-eeggadhaa.
appFeatures.contentAm: ለደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ንግድ ምርጥ ልምዶች፦ 1. ማንኛውንም ክፍያ ከመፈጸምዎ በፊት ንብረቱን በአካል ያረጋግጡ። 2. በሕዝብ ቦታዎች ይገናኙ። 3. ከቅድሚያ ክፍያ ይጠንቀቁ።

appSettings.homepageHeading: The Smart Way to Discover, Connect & Grow
appSettings.homepageSubheading: Buy, sell, rent, hire, and connect with confidence through verified listings, trusted businesses, and secure services—all in one modern marketplace.
appSettings.termsAndPrivacy: Sof Umer guarantees user security. All listed properties are audited for legal compliance before publishing. Transactions are processed manually by our finance team.

answer.en: Sof Umer is Ethiopia's premier trusted digital marketplace where individuals, businesses, and communities buy, sell, rent, and discover properties, vehicles, jobs, services, products, and community events.
answer.om: Sof Umer gabaa naannoo Itoophiyaa amansiisaa fi ammayyaa ta'eedha, daldaltoonni, bitattoonni fi hawaasni manneen, konkolaattota, meeshota, hojii fi tajaajiloota adda addaa itti wal-qunnamaniidha.
answer.am: ሶፍ ኡመር ሰዎች ንብረቶችን፣ ተሽከርካሪዎችን፣ ስራዎችን፣ ምርቶችን፣ አገልግሎቶችን እና የአካባቢ ንግዶችን የሚያገኙበት፣ የሚገዙበት፣ የሚሸጡበት እና የሚከራዩበት የታመነ የኢትዮጵያ የገበያ ቦታ ነው።

question.en: How do I create an account and complete verification?
question.om: Herrega akkamitti banna fi eenyummaa mirkaneessina?
question.am: መለያ እንዴት እፈጥራለሁ እና ማረጋገጫ አጠናቅቃለሁ?

answer.en: Click Sign Up at the top right, select Email, Phone Number, or Google login, complete your personal details, and verify your phone or email to gain trusted seller status.
answer.om: Cilika "Sign Up" garagala mirga gubbaa, Imeelii, Bilbila ykn Google filadhu, odaffannoo guutii mirkaneessi.
answer.am: በቀኝ በኩል "ይመዝገቡ" የሚለውን ይጫኑ፣ በኢሜል፣ በስልክ ቁጥር ወይም በጉግል ይግቡ፣ መረጃዎን ያጠናቅቁ እና ያረጋግጡ።

question.en: How do I post a property listing for sale or rent?
question.om: Beeksisa mana ykn lafaa akkamitti gurgurtaa ykn kireessaaf dhiyeessina?
question.am: የቤት ወይም የመሬት ማስታወቂያ ለሽያጭ ወይም ለኪራይ እንዴት እለጥፋለሁ?

answer.en: Click "Post Listing", select Properties, enter the precise location, price, property type (Villa, Apartment, Office, Commercial, Land), upload clear photos, and submit for instant publishing.
answer.om: "Post Listing" cuqaasi, Properties filadhu, iddoo, gatii, gosa mana (Viillaa, Appaartamaa, Lafa) galchi, suuraa qulqulluu irratti fe'i.
answer.am: "ማስታወቂያ ይለጥፉ" የሚለውን ይጫኑ፣ ንብረቶችን ይምረጡ፣ ቦታ፣ ዋጋ፣ የንብረት አይነት (ቪላ፣ አፓርታማ፣ መሬት) ያስገቡ እና ምስሎችን ያክሉ።

question.en: What documents are needed for Verified Property badge?
question.om: Mallattoo Mirkanaa'aa Manaa (Verified Badge) argachuuf sanadiin maal barbaachisa?
question.am: የተረጋገጠ የንብረት ባጅ ለማግኘት ምን ሰነዶች ያስፈልጋሉ?

answer.en: To obtain a verified green checkmark badge, upload a clear photograph of your site title deed (Kaarta) and your national ID. Admin inspects and approves within 24 hours.
answer.om: Mallattoo qulqulluu argachuuf sanada abbummaa (Kaarta) fi waraqaa eenyummaa keessan admin-iif ergaa. Sa'aatii 24 keessatti mirkanaa'a.
answer.am: የተረጋገጠ አረንጓዴ ባጅ ለማግኘት የካርታ እና የመታወቂያ ፎቶ ለአስተዳዳሪው ያጋሩ። በ24 ሰዓት ውስጥ ይረጋገጣል።

question.en: How do I post job vacancies and recruit candidates?
question.om: Beeksisa hojii akkamitti baasna fi kandidaatota qacarta?
question.am: የስራ ማስታወቂያዎችን እንዴት እለጥፋለሁ እና አመልካቾችን እቀጥራለሁ?

answer.en: Select the "Jobs" category when creating a new listing, provide the job title, company name, required qualifications, salary range, and candidate application instructions.
answer.om: Yeroo beeksisa baastu "Jobs" filadhu, maqaa hojii, maqaa dhaabbataa, dandeettii barbaachisu fi mindaa galchi.
answer.am: ማስታወቂያ በሚፈጥሩበት ጊዜ "ስራዎች" ምድብ ይምረጡ፣ የስራ መደብ፣ የድርጅት ስም፣ አስፈላጊ ክህሎቶችን እና ደሞዝ ያስገቡ።

question.en: Can I sell electronics, furniture, or personal goods?
question.om: Meeshaalee ellektirooniksi, mi'a mana fi meeshaa dhuunfaa gurguruu danda'aa?
question.am: ኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ የቤት እቃዎችን ወይም የግል እቃዎችን መሸጥ እችላለሁ?

answer.en: Yes! Sof Umer supports selling new and pre-owned items including smartphones, laptops, clothing, home furniture, and vehicle accessories with clear pricing and photo galleries.
answer.om: Eeyyee! Meeshaalee haaraa fi tajaajilaman kanneen akka bilbilaa, kompiyuutara, uffata fi mi'a mana gurguruu dandeessu.
answer.am: አዎ! አዳዲስ እና ያገለገሉ ስልኮችን፣ ላፕቶፖችን፣ አልባሳትን እና የቤት እቃዎችን መሸጥ ይችላሉ።

question.en: How do freelancers and technicians list their services?
question.om: Ogeeyyiin fi teekniishinoonni tajaajila isaanii akkamitti galmeessisu?
question.am: ባለሙያዎች እና ቴክኒሺያኖች አገልግሎታቸውን እንዴት ይዘረዝራሉ?

answer.en: Create a listing under "Services", select your specialty (Plumbing, Electrical, IT, Legal, Moving, Design), set hourly or fixed pricing, and publish your direct contact details.
answer.om: Tajaajila keessan "Services" jalatti galcheera, gosa dandaettii keessanii (Pulaambingii, Elektirika, IT, Seera) filadhaa.
answer.am: አገልግሎትዎን "አገልግሎቶች" ስር ይዘርዝሩ፣ የሙያ ዘርፍዎን ይምረጡ፣ የሰዓት ወይም የቋሚ ዋጋ ያስገቡ።

question.en: How can local businesses feature their enterprise on Sof Umer?
question.om: Dhaabbileen naannoo daldala isaanii akkamitti beeksifatu?
question.am: የአካባቢ ንግዶች ድርጅታቸውን በሶፍ ኡመር ላይ እንዴት ማስተዋወቅ ይችላሉ?

answer.en: Register your store under "Local Businesses". Include your physical address, Google Maps location link, opening hours, business phone numbers, and official logo.
answer.om: "Local Businesses" jalatti suuqii ykn dhaabbata keessan galmeessisaa, teessoo, kaffaltii fi lakkoofsa bilbilaa qopheessaa.
answer.am: ድርጅትዎን "የአካባቢ ንግዶች" ስር ያስመዝግቡ። አድራሻዎን፣ የስራ ሰዓትዎን እና የስልክ ቁጥርዎን ያካቱ።

question.en: What community announcements and notices are allowed?
question.om: Beeksisa hawaasaa fi beeksisa kamtu eeyyamamaa?

answer.en: You can share local charity events, public gatherings, neighbourhood notices, educational workshops, and community lost-and-found items for free.
answer.om: Qophii tola-ooltummaa, beeksisa naannoo, barumsa fi walga'ii hawaasaa bilisaan qoodachuu dandeessu.
answer.am: የበጎ አድራጎት ዝግጅቶችን፣ የማህበረሰብ ማስታወቂያዎችን እና ትምህርታዊ ስልጠናዎችን በነፃ ማጋራት ይችላሉ።

question.en: How does the Make Offer and Chat system work?
question.om: Sirni "Make Offer" fi Chaatii akkamitti hojjata?
question.am: የዋጋ እቅረብ (Make Offer) እና የቻት ስርዓት እንዴት ይሰራሉ?

answer.en: On any listing detail page, click "Make Offer" to propose your purchase price, or click "Chat" to send an instant direct message. Sellers receive immediate notifications to accept, counter, or reject.
answer.om: Fuula beeksisaa irratti "Make Offer" cuqaasuun gatii dhiyeessaa, ykn "Chat" cuqaasuun ergaa kallattii ergaa. Gurguraan counter/accept gochuu danda'a.
answer.am: በማስታወቂያው ገጽ ላይ "Make Offer" በመጫን የገዢ ዋጋ ያቅርቡ ወይም "Chat" በመጫን ቀጥታ መልእክት ይላኩ።

question.en: How do I boost or feature my listing with Telebirr or CBE?
question.om: Telebirr ykn CBE-n beeksisa koo akkamitti ol-kaasa (boost)?
question.am: በቴሌብር ወይም በንግድ ባንክ ማስታወቂያዬን እንዴት ላስተዋውቅ (Boost)?

answer.en: Go to your Dashboard or listing options, select "Boost Listing", choose your package (Basic, Featured, or VIP), transfer payment to our registered CBE/Telebirr account, and upload the transaction receipt screenshot for instant activation.
answer.om: Kellaa keessaniin "Boost Listing" filadhaa, Telebirr ykn CBE kaffalaa, risiiti kaffaltii fe'aa.
answer.am: ከዳሽቦርድዎ "Boost Listing" ይምረጡ፣ ጥቅሉን ይምረጡ፣ በቴሌብር ወይም በንግድ ባንክ ይክፈሉ እና ደረሰኙን ይስቀሉ።

question.en: What safety precautions should I take during transactions?
question.am: በግዢ እና ሽያጭ ወቅት ምን አይነት የደህንነት ጥንቃቄዎችን ማድረግ አለብኝ?

answer.en: Never send advance money transfers to unknown sellers. Inspect properties or physical items in person in busy public locations before making payments. Report any fraudulent activity immediately.
answer.om: Kaffaltii dursaa eenyummaa isaanii kan hin beekamneef maallaqa hin ergininaa. Iddoo ummataatti wal-argaa maallaqa kaffaluun dura ijaan sakatta'aa.
answer.am: ለማያውቁት ሰው በቅድሚያ ገንዘብ አይላኩ። ክፍያ ከመፈጸምዎ በፊት ንብረቱን በሕዝብ ቦታዎች በአካል ያረጋግጡ።

question.en: What content or listings are strictly prohibited on Sof Umer?
question.om: Qabiyyee fi beeksisi kamtu dhorkamaa ta'ee?
question.am: በሶፍ ኡመር ላይ በጥብቅ የተከለከሉ ይዘቶች ምንድን ናቸው?

answer.en: Illegal drugs, weapons, counterfeit goods, fraudulent investments, deceptive prices, duplicate listings, and abusive content are strictly prohibited and result in permanent account termination.
answer.om: Dawaa seeraan ala ta'e, meeshaa waraanaa, beeksisa fakkaattii fi sobaa fayyadamuun dhorkamaadha.
answer.am: ህገ-ወጥ እቃዎች፣ መሳሪያዎች፣ የሃሰት ማስታወቂያዎች እና አታላይ መረጃዎች በጥብቅ የተከለከሉ ናቸው።

question.en: How can I contact Sof Umer support team directly?
question.om: Garee deggarsa Sof Umer akkamitti kallattiin quunnama?
question.am: የሶፍ ኡመር የድጋፍ ቡድንን በቀጥታ እንዴት ማግኘት እችላለሁ?

answer.en: You can submit a ticket on this page under "Send a Support Inquiry", email support@sofumer.com, call +251 911 000 000 during office hours (Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM), or visit our head office in Addis Ababa.
answer.om: Ergaa deggarsaa "Send a Support Inquiry" kanaan ergaa, support@sofumer.com ykn bilbila +251 911 000 000 fayyadamaa.
answer.am: በዚህ ገጽ ላይ መልእክት ይላኩ፣ ወደ support@sofumer.com ኢሜል ያድርጉ ወይም በ +251 911 000 000 ይደውሉ።
